proposal.summary: The 29 placeholders sit in four CM550 modules: the trip information task (0x303d4-0x30b0e), the engine data trending feature (0x31496-0x31acc, e2m group TRENDING), the J1939 broadcast and request builders with their transmit descriptor set-ups (0x31b96-0x34512), and the wet stack timing step (0x34d52). The J1939 builders have no callers by name. They are reached through scheduleJ1939PeriodicMessage(queue, PGN, interval, offset, builder) in mc68k_initializeJ1939Datalink, or through the PGN 59904 request registrar 0x2f47e (32 entries at 0x801d5a, dispatched by 0x2f4be). Most descriptor set-ups are called from cm550_diagnosticDataDump. CM550's descriptor set-up order matches CM848's J1939 initializer one for one, and the schedule constants are the same. That parallel locates the counterparts. Three functions are exact twins: the EC1 send and send-on-change pair and the FD1 descriptor set-up. The other J1939 functions differ from CM848's in fault checks, extra fields or extra stores. The trending and trip functions own e2m blocks 1214-1217, 117F and 126C-126E. The trending storage table in the RAM dump decodes into 24 plausible records taken about every 100 h, which confirms the layout the code writes. None of the functions with a vp44_ name touches the pump.

functions.role: While any of the six engine brake solenoid driver outputs is commanded on, adds one 0.1 s count to the trip and lifetime engine brake time counters.
functions.discriminator: Its trip information siblings count idle time (0x30414: TIT2ISTM / TIT3ISTM) and power take-off time (0x30454: TIT3PTTM / TIT2PTTM) from the trip state. This body tests the engine brake driver output bits (0x80bcf7 bit 0 and five tests of 0x80bcf9 bit 6) and increments only TIT3EBTM 0x80615e and TIT2EBTM 0x806176.
functions.plate_comment: Trip information step that cm550_updateTripInformation calls while the engine turns (bsr at 0x30a3c, 100 ms). When engine brake driver 1 (output image byte 0x80bcf7 bit 0, e2m 000E +29 EBDR1) or drivers 2-6 (0x80bcf9 bit 6, output 30 in this build) is on, it adds one 0.1 s count to trip_engine_brake_time (e2m 1216 +38 TIT3EBTM) and lifetime_engine_brake_time (1216 +50 TIT2EBTM). cm550_ioControlBasedFuelCalculator makes the same six tests to add up the braking cylinders. CM848's trip counters keep no engine brake time.
functions.evidence: ROM 0x30498-0x304f2: movea.l #0x80bcf6,a0; move.b (1,a0),d0 / andi.l #1 / bne; then five times move.b (3,a0),d0 / andi.l #0x40 / bne (last beq 0x304f2); 0x304e6 addq.l #1,(0x80615e).l; 0x304ec addq.l #1,(0x806176).l; rts. Only reference: bsr.w at 0x30a3c in 0x306ca, run only when the trip state is not 0. e2m v64t6_s.e2m: TIT3EBTM 1216 +38 'THE ENGINE OPERATING TIME WITH THE ENGINE BRAKES ON SINCE L(AST TRIP RESET)' resolves to 0x80615e; TIT2EBTM 1216 +50 'TOTAL NON-RESETABLE TIME THIS ENGINE HAS HAD THE ENGINE (BRAKES ON)' resolves to 0x806176; HR scale 2.77777E-5 = 0.1 s per count. EBDR1 = 000E +29 mask 01. cm550_ioControlBasedFuelCalculator (0xff6c) tests the same six bits and adds indicates_of_cyl_brakes_driven_by_eb_driver_1..6. The trip reset clears 0x80615e (clr.l at 0x3075c) but not 0x806176. cm848_updateTripAndLifetimeCounters has no engine brake counter.

functions.role: The 100 ms trip information task. It applies a tool's trip reset, classifies the trip information engine state, counts engine run time, forms the fuel increment and the J1939 / J1587 fuel rates, and accumulates fuel used and the idle, power take-off, engine brake and smart power times.
functions.discriminator: Only this body reads the trip reset request TIRF 0x80de66. It writes the trip information engine state TIEGST 0x80de64, the fuel increment TIFU 0x80de54, the lifetime / trip run time counters 0x80613a / 0x806162 and the 117F report copies. It dispatches per state to the accumulators 0x303d4 / 0x30414 / 0x30454, then calls 0x30498 and the histogram step 0x304f4.
functions.plate_comment: The trip information task (cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase19, 100 ms), run while algorithm_enable_flags_3_cal.trip_information_enable is set. A tool's reset request (trip_counters_reset_pending_flag, e2m 1215 +14 TIRF) zeroes the trip records and the 25 speed histogram bins. It then sets trip_information_engine_state (1215 +12 TIEGST: 0 engine off / 1 idle / 2 power take-off governor / 3 driving) and counts lifetime_engine_run_time and trip_engine_run_time (1216 +14 TIT2TM / +3C TIT3TM, 0.1 s); total_engine_operating_time (117F +20 TITMT2) = TIT2TM + the tool offset 1217 +2. It forms the fuel increment instantaneous_fuel_rate_raw (1215 +2 TIFU) from TIFSRT or TIITFU (selected by 1214 +4 TIFSSW) and the J1939 and averaged J1587 rate words, and adds lifetime and trip fuel (copies in 117F +0 / +4). Per state it adds the drive fuel or calls the idle or power take-off counters, then calls cm550_countEngineBrakeTime, counts the electronic smart power high horsepower time while the tau 0x80d2b4 is non-zero (1216 +58 / +5C) and calls cm550_rpmHistogramAndAveragingStatistics. Overflows and a fuel system fault that lasts past 1214 +2 TIFUTMTD set bits in trip_information_fault_status (1216 +28 TIFUSS). Counterpart of cm848_updateTripAndLifetimeCounters, which keeps no power take-off, engine brake or smart power times.
functions.evidence: jsr at 0x1b868 (cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase19). 0x306e0 move.w 0x803c9a / andi.w #0x200 (trip_information_enable). 0x306ee cmpi.w #1,(0x80de66): clr.w 0x80de66; 25 x clr.l from 0x8060c2; clr.l 0x806126..0x806162, 0x80617e, 0x80618e, 0x806192, 0x804fa4. State at 0x30792-0x307da: 0x80ccf4 == 0 -> 0; 0x80dc26 == 1 -> 2; (0x80a9d0 == 0 and 0x80a9ee VSSVF == 1) or (0x80d330 == 11 and VSSVF != 1) -> 1; else 3. 0x307f0-0x3081e addq.l 0x80613a (overflow 0x10) and 0x806162 (0x400). 0x30824-0x3084a 0x804fc0 = 0x80613a + 0x80401e, saturating at 0xffffffff. 0x30850-0x308c6 TIFU = TIFSRT 0x80d354 x 0x5000000 / 0x39c2c30 when 0x808a56 == 1, else (0x80619a - 0x801e82) x 0x800000 / 0x808a6a. 0x30918-0x309a6 J1939 rate word 0x80de62 = TIFU x 0x232893 / 0x800000; J1587 word 0x80de60 = 3-sample average. 0x309ac / 0x309ca: 0x303d4 for lifetime fuel 0x80617a (overflow 0x20) and trip fuel 0x806142 (0x800); copies to 0x804fa0 / 0x804fa4. 0x30a1e-0x30a54: state 3 -> 0x303d4(0x806126, 0x80613e); 1 -> bsr 0x30414; 2 -> bsr 0x30454; bsr 0x30498; tst.w 0x80d2b4 -> addq.l 0x80617e and 0x806182; bsr 0x304f4. The e2m records resolve as named (blocks 1214 / 1215 / 1216 / 1217 / 117F / 11DC +4 SPTU). The CM848 body at 0x523148 counts only run time, idle time and fuel, and takes distance from PCI message 11.

functions.role: A power-down step that marks the trip information fault status when stored data may be lost: an EEPROM write failure, too many incomplete power-downs, or no parameter block loaded at start-up.
functions.discriminator: It runs once, as the first call of mc68k_runPowerDownSequence. It only ORs fault bits into TIFUSS 0x80614e: 0x2 / 0x80 from eeprom_write_failure_flag_cal, 0x8 / 0x200 from system error 11, and 0x1000 / 0x2000 from system error 12. It counts nothing.
functions.plate_comment: First call of mc68k_runPowerDownSequence (0x27fb0). While algorithm_enable_flags_3_cal.trip_information_enable is set, it ORs bits into trip_information_fault_status (e2m 1216 +28 TIFUSS). It sets 0x02 and 0x80 when eeprom_write_failure_flag_cal (1069 +8 SDEEWRFU) is set. It sets 0x08 and 0x200 for system error 11 (status word 0 bit 0x800, set by cm550_loadParameterBlockAndUpdatePowerDownCounts when consecutive_incomplete_power_down_count_cal passes its limit) and 0x1000 and 0x2000 for system error 12 (bit 0x1000: no parameter block was loaded at start-up); each error counts only when its fault_processing_enable_flags bit is also set. Counterpart of cm848_flagTripInformationPowerDownDataLoss, which sets only 0x208 on power_down_data_lost_error.
functions.evidence: ROM 0x30a5e-0x30adc: andi.w #0x200 of 0x803c9a / beq rts; tst.w 0x803fdc -> ori.l #2 and #0x80 to 0x80614e; 0x806000 & 0x800 and (a0=0x806abc) & 0x800 -> ori.l #8 and #0x200; 0x806000 & 0x1000 and 0x806abc & 0x1000 -> ori.l #0x1000 and #0x2000. Only reference: jsr at 0x27fb0 in mc68k_runPowerDownSequence, its first call. Setters in cm550_loadParameterBlockAndUpdatePowerDownCounts (0x114d4): bit 0x1000 at LAB_000115ca when parameter_block_uploaded == 0; bit 0x800 when consecutive_incomplete_power_down_count_cal > consecutive_incomplete_power_down_limit. The CM848 body at 0x523760 is one test of power_down_data_lost_error that ORs 0x208, with no enable gate.

functions.role: An empty function (a single rts) that mc68k_applicationMain calls once as a start-up step.
functions.discriminator: The body is the one instruction 0x4e75. Its only reference is the jsr at 0x28774 in the start-up list, between mc68k_scheduler_init and the undumped 0x42ad4.
functions.plate_comment: Empty function (a single rts). Its one call is a start-up step of mc68k_applicationMain (jsr at 0x28774, progress word 0x877a), after mc68k_scheduler_init and before the undumped 0x42ad4. CM848's start-up list has no step in that place.
functions.evidence: ROM 0x30b0e = 4e 75. 0x30b04-0x30b0c just before it is an empty interrupt handler (movem push / movem pop / rte), and 0x30b10 starts cm550_applyMaximumTimingAdvanceLimit. callers.py finds one reference: jsr.l 4eb9 0003 0b0e at 0x28774, preceded by the 0x810ffc = 0x877a progress store. Existing CM550 stubs are cm550_emptyStubFunction1 / 4 / 7 / 10 (9 is deleted), so 11 is the next number. This confirms round 93's F1 judge.

functions.role: Every 100 ms while the trending capture window is open, checks the engine speed, engine load, intake manifold temperature and coolant temperature against their trending windows and times how long all four hold.
functions.discriminator: It is the only reader of the trending trigger limits (e2m 126C +6..+14). It is the only writer of the four window flags 0x801e98 / 0x801e9a / 0x801e9c / 0x801e9e and TRTRCD 0x804a08, and it drives the trigger hold timer and the satisfied flag TRTRCDTM / TRTRCDTR. Its siblings run the interval and the records (0x315be) and the rebuild restart (0x31a68).
functions.plate_comment: Engine data trending trigger check, the first call of cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase5 (100 ms). It runs when algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal.trending_enable is set, the engine is not stopped and the trending interval window is open (trending_interval_window_active_flag_cal, e2m 126D +1A TRITWNAE). It then sets one flag per window, each value above the lower limit and up to the upper limit (126C +6..+14): engine speed (TRESMN / TRESMX), engine load at current speed (TRPCLDMN / TRPCLDMX), intake manifold temperature from A/D channel 0 (TRIMTPMN / TRIMTPMX) and coolant temperature from channel 6 (TRCQMN / TRCQMX). While all four hold, it sets trending_all_triggers_satisfied_flag_cal (126D +1E TRTRCD) and counts trending_trigger_hold_timer_cal (TRTRCDTM, 0.1 s) up to 10 x TRTRSATM, then sets trending_trigger_satisfied_flag_cal (TRTRCDTR); a missed window clears all three. CM848 has no trending feature.
functions.evidence: jsr at 0x1b7b0 (first call of cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase5). Gates: 0x803cb8 & 0x10 (cm550_algorithm_enable_flags_18_t.trending_enable), engine_state != 1, 0x804a04 == 1. Compares: cmp.w 0x808a80 at 0x314de, 0x808a82 at 0x314ec, 0x808a88 at 0x31526, 0x808a8a at 0x3152e, 0x808a8c at 0x31544, 0x808a8e at 0x3154c. Stores 0x801e98 / 0x801e9a / 0x801e9c / 0x801e9e. 0x804a08 = 1 at 0x31570, clr.w at 0x315a6. Hold timer 0x804a00 compared with 0x808a7e x 10, then 0x804a02 = 1. e2m 126C +6 TRESMX / +8 TRESMN / +A TRPCLDMX / +C TRPCLDMN / +E TRIMTPMX / +10 TRIMTPMN / +12 TRCQMX / +14 TRCQMN; 126D +16 TRTRCDTM (SEC 0.1) / +18 TRTRCDTR / +1E TRTRCD. Dump: TRESMN 2000 rpm, TRESMX 2350 rpm, TRTRSATM 3 s. CM848 has no TR* records and no trending code.

functions.role: Once a minute, runs the engine data trending interval and its capture window, accumulates the engine load, and writes trending sample records into the long-term storage table: oil pressure, boost, coolant temperature, fuel consumption, load and a time stamp.
functions.discriminator: It is the only writer of the interval and window counters (TRITTM / TRITWNLM / TRITWNTM / TRITWNAE / TRITWNAL), the load accumulators (TRAVNOCU / TRLDRNT2), the per-interval averages and the time stamp (TRAVFLCN / TRLDINAV / TRTQCDID / TRTMST), the fuel snapshot TRFLUSSR, and the storage table TRSATB with its index TRSAIN and count TRNOSATN.
functions.plate_comment: Engine data trending interval: the frame-3 call of executiveFrameInterruptHandler (jsr at 0x1b9ea, once per 40-frame cycle), divided by 0x801ea0 to once a minute. With trending_enable set and the engine not stopped, it snapshots lifetime_fuel_used at the interval start (e2m 126D +2C TRFLUSSR). It counts TRITTM up to the interval length (2000 minutes until 3 samples are stored, then 126C +2 TRITTR hours x 60), then runs a capture window of a tenth of that length (TRITWNLM / TRITWNTM, flag TRITWNAE). Each minute it adds duty_cycle_monitor_load_factor to TRLDRNT2 and counts TRAVNOCU. In record TRSAIN of trending_storage_table_cal (126E TRSATB, 100 records of 14 bytes), it writes oil pressure, boost pressure and coolant temperature while the window is open and the triggers have held (TRTRCDTR). When the window closes, it adds the average fuel consumption (TRAVFLCN, fuel since the snapshot per hour), the average load (TRLDINAV) and the time stamp (TRTMST: engine_hour_meter with the torque curve byte of throttle_100_fueling). When a fault_count_table entry has status 1 or 3, the record is written zeroed instead. It then advances the index (it wraps at 126C +0 TRNOSARQ and keeps the first 3 records once the table is full), counts TRNOSATN and restarts the interval. CM848 has no trending feature.
functions.evidence: jsr at 0x1b9ea, the 6th call of the frame-3 case (move.w #4,(a4) follows). 0x315da addq.w / cmpi.w #0x12c (300 x 200 ms). Gates at 0x315e6 (0x803cb8 & 0x10) and 0x315f4 (engine_state 1). 0x31608 move.l 0x80617a -> 0x804a16 while 0x8049f4 == 0. 0x31612-0x3162e: length 0x7d0 while 0x8049fa < 3, else 0x808a7c x 60. 0x31638-0x3167c: interval, window limit = length / 10 (0x8049f6), window counter 0x8049f8, 0x804a04. 0x31682 addq.w 0x804a0a; 0x31690 add.l 0x80bad4 to 0x804a0c. 0x3169c loop: 125 x 10-byte status bytes at 0x805a24, == 1 or 3. Records at 0x804a1a / 0x804a1c / 0x804a1e / 0x804a20 / 0x804a22 (word) and 0x804a24 (long), index x 14 (lsl #3 - sub, d0.w*2). 0x317dc-0x31804: (0x80617a - 0x804a16) / ((0x8049f4 + 0x8049f8) / 60) -> 0x804a14. 0x3182c-0x3183e: 0x804a0c / 0x804a0a -> 0x804a10. 0x3185e-0x318a2: 0x80ccee & 0xffffff00 -> 0x8049f0; 0x80d368 & 0xff00 -> 0x804a12; record dword = 0x8049f0 | 0x804a12 >> 8. 0x318ac-0x318ec: index wrap at (0x808a7a); count reset to 3 with index + 3. RAM dump: TRNOSARQ 100; 24 records decode to 35.5 / 70.4 / 107.6 h (the 2000-minute rule) and then about every 100 h from 10427 h to 12460 h (TRITTR 100), with coolant 185-199 F, 2.25-3.75 GPH and load 23-36 %.

functions.role: At start-up, when a service tool has set the trending engine rebuild flag, restarts the trending interval and sample count and stamps the rebuild time.
functions.discriminator: It is the only reader of TRRBOC 0x8049ea and the only writer of TRNOSARB 0x8049fe and TRRBTMST 0x8049ec. mc68k_applicationMain calls it once.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up step of mc68k_applicationMain (jsr at 0x287f8, right after cm550_initializeTripInformation). When algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal.trending_enable is set and trending_engine_rebuild_flag_cal is non-zero (e2m 126D +0 TRRBOC 'flag that indicates when (if) an engine rebuild occurred'), it clears the interval and window timers and flags (TRITTM / TRITWNTM / TRTRCDTM / TRTRCDTR / TRITWNAE / TRITWNAL), the load count TRAVNOCU, the load accumulator TRLDRNT2 and the rebuild flag. It moves the stored sample count TRNOSATN into trending_sample_count_before_rebuild_cal (TRNOSARB) and zeroes it. It stamps trending_engine_rebuild_time_stamp_cal (TRRBTMST) with engine_hour_meter. CM848 has no trending feature.
functions.evidence: ROM 0x31a68-0x31acc: andi.w #0x10 of 0x803cb8 / tst.w 0x8049ea / clr.w 0x8049f4, 0x8049f8, 0x804a00, 0x804a02, 0x804a04, 0x804a06, 0x804a0a, 0x8049ea / move.w 0x8049fa -> 0x8049fe / clr.w 0x8049fa / move.l 0x80ccee (engine_hour_meter) -> 0x8049ec / clr.l 0x804a0c. Only reference: jsr at 0x287f8 in mc68k_applicationMain (progress word 0x87fe). e2m 126D +0 TRRBOC, +2 TRRBTMST (SEC 0.2, 4 bytes), +14 TRNOSARB 'number of samples taken by trending feature before rebuild flag', +10 TRNOSATN. Dump: TRRBOC 0.

functions.role: Builds and sends the ECM's PGN 65269 Ambient Conditions broadcast, which here carries only the barometric pressure.
functions.discriminator: It writes only payload byte 1 (0x801eca), from ambient_air_pressure_sensor_state.filtered_value, and sends j1939_pgn65269_tx_message. The descriptor is set up by 0x31c1a, so this is the transmit step, not the set-up.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the ECM's AMB broadcast (PGN 65269). It runs every 1000 ms from 170 ms on queue 0, and as the PGN 59904 request responder for 65269 that cm550_diagnosticDataDump registers. Byte 1 is j1939_pgn65269_barometric_pressure (SPN 108, 0.5 kPa/bit) = (ambient_air_pressure_sensor_state.filtered_value x 2) x 6906 / 1000 >> 7. The other bytes keep the not-available values that cm550_j1939MessageSetup_PGN_65265 (the 65269 descriptor set-up) stored. It sends j1939_pgn65269_tx_message with cm550_sendCanMessage. Counterpart of cm848_buildPgn65269AmbientConditionsMessage: the same formula, but CM848 sends 0xFE on the pressure fault bits and adds the ambient air temperature.
functions.evidence: ROM 0x31bce-0x31c18: move.w 0x80a3ba; x2 & 0xffff; x 0x1afa (shift / add); divu.l #0x3e8; asr.l #7; move.b -> 0x801eca; pea 0x801ebc; jsr 0x104e8. Schedule at 0x28d74: pea 0x31bce / 0xaa / 0x3e8 / 0xfef5 / queue 0. Request registration at 0x2f5b6: pea 0x31bce / move.w #0xfef5 / jsr (a2 = 0x2f47e). The CM848 body at 0x23e8c has the same (x2 & 0xffff) x 0x1afa / 1000 >> 7, plus 0xfe on ambient_air_pressure_high / low errors and bytes 4-5 ambient temperature.

functions.role: Sets up the PGN 65265 (CCVS1) transmit descriptor and registers the CCVS1 builder as the request responder for 65265.
functions.discriminator: It sets descriptor fields only: header 0xfef100 with the 0x803f52 priority, data length 8 and payload byte 1 = 0xf3. It registers 0x31c84 for PGN 0xfef1 with 0x2f47e. It builds no signal values.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up step, the second descriptor set-up of mc68k_initializeJ1939Datalink. It builds the CCVS1 transmit descriptor j1939_pgn65265_tx_message (header 0xfef100: PGN 65265 Cruise Control/Vehicle Speed 1): the priority from the word 0x803f52 (e2m 1254 +4 JCCRVSPZ) & 7, j1939_engine_node_source_address, data length 8, data pointer ccvs_message_byte_0 and status pointer j1939_pgn65265_transmit_status. It sets payload byte 1 to 0xf3. It then registers j1939HandlePgn65265CruiseVehicleSpeed (the CCVS1 builder) for PGN 65265 with the PGN 59904 request registrar 0x2f47e. Counterpart of cm848_initPgn65265CruiseSpeedHandler, which also starts ccvs1_cruise_control_state at 7.
functions.evidence: ROM 0x31ed2-0x31f2e: move.l #0xfef100,(0x801ed4); priority from 0x803f52 & 7 << 2 into byte 0; SA 0x80da01 into byte 3; move.w #8,(4,a0); data 0x801ee2; status 0x801eea; move.b #0xf3,(0x801ee2); pea 0x31c84 / move.w #0xfef1 / jsr 0x2f47e. Called by jsr at 0x28be2, the 2nd descriptor set-up. CM848 0x24664 has the same stores plus li r11,7 / sth to 0x40a2bc (ccvs1_cruise_control_state) before bl 0x23188.

functions.role: The request responder for PGN 65259 Component Identification: copies the make, model, serial number and unit number from the dataplate into the 40-byte payload with '*' delimiters and sends it.
functions.discriminator: It is the only writer of the 40-byte payload 0x801f12, and the only reader of the unit number 0x803ebb. The descriptor set-up is 0x320f6. The other dataplate reader 0x277e6 builds the J1587 reply.
functions.plate_comment: The PGN 59904 request responder for PGN 65259 (CI Component Identification), registered by cm550_engineSerialNumberPGN_65259_Builder (0x320f6, the CI descriptor set-up). It fills j1939_pgn65259_payload (40 bytes) with the make (5 bytes from component_identification_make_cal, 'CMMNS'), '*', the model (17 bytes, 'ISB 195'), '*', the 4 raw bytes of component_identification_serial_number_cal, '*', the 10-byte unit number and a final '*'. These are SPNs 586 / 587 / 588 / 233, from the e2m 0006 DAT_PLAT dataplate. It sends j1939_pgn65259_tx_message. Counterpart of cm848_j1939HandlePgn65259ComponentId, which writes the serial number as 8 decimal digits (44 bytes).
functions.evidence: ROM 0x32052-0x320f4: four copy loops into 0x801f12 (5 bytes from 0x803dcc, 17 from 0x803dd1, 4 from 0x803de2, 10 from 0x803ebb) with move.b #0x2a at +5 / +0x17 / +0x1c / +0x27; pea 0x801f04; jsr 0x104e8. Only reference: pea at 0x32138 in 0x320f6, then move.w #0xfeeb and jsr 0x2f47e. The descriptor data length is 0x28. RAM dump: 0x803dcc 'CMMNS', 0x803dd1 'ISB 195', 0x803de2 03 5e 4b 37, 0x803ebb ten spaces. e2m 0006 +0 DAT_PLAT -> 0x803dca, 332 bytes. CM848 0x24870 calls cm848_formatNumberAsDecimalText(..., 8) and its descriptor data length is 0x2c.

functions.role: Sets up the PGN 61441 (EBC1) transmit descriptor and seeds two not-available payload bytes.
functions.discriminator: It sets descriptor fields only: header 0xf00100 with the 0x803f90 priority, data length 5, payload bytes 1 and 3 = 0xff. The EBC1 builder at 0x32bbc fills bytes 4-5. It has no VP44 access.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up step, the third descriptor set-up of mc68k_initializeJ1939Datalink. It builds the EBC1 transmit descriptor j1939_pgn61441_tx_message (header 0xf00100: PGN 61441 Electronic Brake Controller 1): the priority from the word 0x803f90 & 7, j1939_engine_node_source_address, data length 5, payload bytes 1 and 3 (0x80347a / 0x80347c) = 0xff, data pointer 0x80347a and status pointer j1939_pgn61441_transmit_status. The builder at 0x32bbc (every 100 ms from 20 ms, no function in the project) fills bytes 4-5. Nothing in it concerns the VP44. Counterpart of cm848_initializePgn61441ElectronicBrakeController1Buffer, which also sets payload byte 2 to 0xff.
functions.evidence: ROM 0x32c22-0x32c74: move.l #0xf00100,(0x803482); 0x803f90 & 7 << 2; SA 0x80da01 into byte 3; move.w #5,(4,a1); move.b #0xff,(0x80347a); move.b #0xff,(2,a0); data a0 = 0x80347a; status 0x803490. Called by jsr at 0x28be8, the 3rd descriptor set-up. The builder 0x32bbc is scheduled at 0x28de6: pea 0x32bbc / 0x14 / 0x64 / 0xf001. roles.role: Engine brake on-time counter of the trip information update. When engine brake driver 1 is commanded (0x80bcf7 bit 0, e2m 000E +29 EBDR1), or bit 6 of 0x80bcf9 is set (tested five times), it adds 1 count (0.1 s) to 0x80615e (e2m 1216 +38 TIT3EBTM, engine brake time since the trip reset) and to 0x806176 (1216 +50 TIT2EBTM, lifetime engine brake time).
roles.discriminator: It is the only trip counter driven by the engine brake output commands. In cm550_ioControlBasedFuelCalculator (0xff6c) the same six bit tests add JCDR1NCY..JCDR6NCY, so the five tests of 0x80bcf9 bit 6 are engine brake drivers 2-6, which this ROM maps to one output bit. The siblings cm550_runTimeCountersUpdate / cm550_runTimeCountersUpdateAlt count idle and PTO time and fuel. The only caller is the trip update 0x306ca (bsr.w @0x30a3c), which calls it on every 100 ms pass while the engine turns.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none. cm848_updateTripAndLifetimeCounters @ 0x523148 counts only engine-run time and governed-speed time, and CM848's e2m has no engine brake time record.

roles.role: The trip information task (cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase19, every 100 ms), gated by algorithm_enable_flags_3_cal.trip_information_enable. A tool trip reset (TIRF 0x80de66 = 1) clears the trip histogram at 0x8060c2, the trip fuel and time records and TIFUSS. It then sets TIEGST (0 engine off, 2 PTO governor active, 1 idle, 3 drive). While the engine turns it counts time (TIT3TM, TITMT2), computes the fuel rate TIFU and its J1939 / J1587 formats, and carries fuel into the lifetime, trip and per-state totals. It then runs the idle, PTO and engine brake counters and finally cm550_rpmHistogramAndAveragingStatistics.
roles.discriminator: It is the parent of the trip family. It owns the TIEGST decision and the trip reset, and it calls cm550_runTimeCountersUpdate (state 1), cm550_runTimeCountersUpdateAlt (state 2) and 0x30498 (engine brake). roles.role: Trending interval timer and data set recorder. Executive frame 3 calls it every 200 ms, and it acts once per 300 calls (60 s) while trending is enabled and the engine is not stopped. While the window and TRTRCDTR hold it stores oil pressure, boost and coolant temperature in the 14-byte TRSATB record at index TRSAIN. enum_roles.meaning: TRIP_INFORMATION_ENGINE_STATE_ENGINE_OFF: the engine is not turning
enum_roles.evidence: 0x306ca sets TIEGST (0x80de64, now fuel_statistics_operating_mode) to 0 when current_engine_rpm_filtered == 0. In state 0 it zeroes the J1939 / J1587 fuel rates and accumulates nothing. e2m 1215 +12 TIEGST 'THE ENGINE STATE AS DETERMINED BY TRIP INFORMATION, ENG_OFF, IDLE, PTO' (range 0-3).

0x306ca sets 1 when road speed is 0 with a valid speed sensor (VSSVF), or when final_fueling_state is LOW_SPEED_GOVERNOR without one. State 1 runs cm550_runTimeCountersUpdate (TIT2ISTM / TIT3ISTM and trip idle fuel).
0x306ca sets 2 when power_take_off_governor_active_flag == 1. State 2 runs cm550_runTimeCountersUpdateAlt (TIT3PTTM / TIT2PTTM and trip PTO fuel).

0x306ca sets 3 in every other case. State 3 carries trip_drive_fuel_used (TIT3VSFU 'fuel consumed with engine not at idle and PTO not active'). The e2m label of value 3 is cut off after 'PTO', and other Cummins e2m files call this total TRIP_DRIVE_FUEL_USED.

verdicts.final_comment: Engine data trending interval: the frame-3 call of executiveFrameInterruptHandler (jsr at 0x1b9ea, once per 40-frame cycle = 200 ms), divided by 300 (counter 0x801ea0) to once a minute. With algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal.trending_enable set and the engine not stopped, it snapshots lifetime_fuel_used at the interval start (e2m 126D +2C TRFLUSSR). It counts TRITTM up to the interval length (2000 minutes while fewer than 3 samples are stored, then 126C +2 TRITTR hours x 60), then runs a capture window a tenth of that length (TRITWNLM / TRITWNTM; TRITWNAE is 1 while it runs). Each minute it adds duty_cycle_monitor_load_factor to TRLDRNT2 and counts TRAVNOCU. Record TRSAIN of trending_storage_table_cal (126E TRSATB, 100 records of 14 bytes) is written in one of three ways. (1) While the window is open and the triggers have held (TRTRCDTR), it stores the oil pressure, boost pressure and coolant temperature filtered values and completes the record at once. (2) When the window closes without that, it zeroes the boost pressure and coolant temperature words. It keeps the oil pressure only when the engine speed, intake manifold temperature and coolant temperature trigger flags are set and the engine load trigger flag is clear; otherwise that word is zeroed too. (3) While any fault_count_table entry is active (status 1 or 3), it writes an all-zero sample when the window closes. Completing a record adds the average fuel consumption (TRAVFLCN: fuel since the snapshot per elapsed hour), the average load (TRLDINAV = TRLDRNT2 / TRAVNOCU) and the time stamp (TRTMST: engine_hour_meter with its low byte replaced by the high byte of throttle_100_fueling, TRTQCDID). It then advances TRSAIN, wrapping at 126C +0 TRNOSARQ, and counts TRNOSATN. When TRNOSATN reaches TRNOSARQ, the count restarts at 3 and the index skips 3, so the first 3 samples are kept. Then the interval restarts. CM848 has no trending feature.
